declared_host_pool.scope: Actual capacity gauge verifies reservation separately from cache residency and total host memory/RSS. Missing is unknown. Do not infer exclusive MOD incremental memory from total container samples.

separate_c8.comparison_scope: Original60/300s submission windows with all requests drained; numerator includes drain tokens and denominator is actual phase end-start. Fixed256/ignoreEOS separate from five EOS metrics. Zero restores establishes no offload benefit; no Bid policy fields.

limits: One ordered cohort, Native all five before Candidate all five; no randomized interleaving or independent repeats.
Native shared judge uses the same model and original frozen grader contracts; unresolved and truncated grades remain denominators.
Zero KV restores is required by fresh salts and proves no cache-reuse benefit on this standard workload.
Observed performance changes cannot identify the fraction caused by save overhead, scheduling, output-length variation or time drift.
No tuning, forced prefix reuse, cross-node tests or rerun was performed during closeout.
